entry.title: 🌱 v2.6.6 — Map-specific farm crops
entry.summary: 📦 SJ88-Wonder-Park · 🌱 v2.6.6 — Map-specific farm crops Each map's farm_plot now produces different crops based on location: - 🎢 Park: 🌸 flowers (auto-replant, 15s, +$12, no seed cost) - 🚜 Farm: 🥕/🍅/🎃 original carrots/tomato/pumpkin (unchanged) - 🌲 Forest: 🍄 mushrooms (10s grow, $5 seed, +$15, purple mesh) - 🏖️ Beach: 🥥 coconuts (90s grow, $40 seed, +$100, brown mesh) Changes: - Add MAP_CROPS dict + getCropsForDeco/getMapCropLabel helpers - placeDecoration() records mapId in farm_plot state - openCropPickerModal()
